name: League of Legends
sources_hint: Liquipedia League of Legends, lol.fandom (Leaguepedia), gol.gg (game stats)
radar_hint: Use the Summoner's Rift of that season (it changed in the 2015 preseason): navigation data or minimap for walls, turret coordinates to project positions (docs/evidence.md). Draw walls as `walls` polygons, abilities as cast/shadow/aoe/line events, spells and HP as `trackers`. Use 'weapon' = champion or spell name in kill events (e.g. 'Ahri R').
